style: Say warmly and clearly, like a land trust guide walking a valley with a student crew.
speaker: Sulafat
lines: Welcome to Reserve Designer. Click a cell on the map to protect it, then read each species row to see what it still needs.
Stress test. Press Run fifty years. Each future loses one protected cell.
Groups. Drag the Herd size slider and count how many elk are watching.
Farm land. Press Buy and farm on, or Buy and restore to meadow for a little more.
Press Build a wildlife crossing to let animals over the highway. It costs five hundred thousand.
That is over budget. Click a protected cell to sell it back, or pick a cheaper cell.
All six species have what they need. Now see if it holds up. Open Stress test.
Fifty years tested. The cracked cells are your weak links.
Test complete. No additional species need broke. Press Back to plan to review your reserve.
Alarm call! The whole colony dives at once.
